name: anime-kinetix-codex-plugin
description: Create and preview Anime.js animations and Matter.js physics scenes, then export editable HTML.

interface.longDescription: Create slide-ins, pulses, staggered entrances, and orbits with Anime.js, or tune gravity, bounce, and shape count in a Matter.js scene. Preview both engines in the playground and export editable HTML. The plugin returns generated markup, which you can ask Codex to save to your workspace.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a bouncing shapes demo with Matter.js and export editable HTML.
